entries.text: My dear friends! How ARE you all today?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_01

entries.text: It’s time for the last of Salvatore’s Language\nLessons! Êtes-vous prêts—are you ready?![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_02

entries.text: Yes!
entries.label: class_d_07_yes_01

entries.text: Oui!
entries.label: class_d_07_yes_02

entries.text: What a réponse fantastique—great answer, that\nis! Perfect for our last class together! I love it![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_03

entries.text: And aujourd’hui—today—we will once again be\nhaving a listening lesson![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_04

entries.text: Vas-y—go for it, my assistant! Pika pi, Pikachu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_05

entries.text: Pikachu!
entries.label: class_d_07_poke_01

entries.text: Let’s get right to it, my little Pikachu friend![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_06

entries.text: For our last listening class...tell everyone how\nyou’re feeling right now, s’il te plaît![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_07

entries.text: Chaaa!
entries.label: class_d_07_poke_02

entries.text: Oooh! Can you feel that? That’s one contagious\nemotion in Pikachu’s voice![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_08

entries.text: What emotion do you suppose Pikachu was\ntrying to convey just now?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_09

entries.text: Happiness
entries.label: class_d_07_select_01

entries.text: Pain
entries.label: class_d_07_select_02

entries.text: Surprise
entries.label: class_d_07_select_03

entries.text: Say it again, Pikachu!
entries.label: class_d_07_select_04

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well done, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! I’m so
HAPPY
that
you
got
it
right!
Haha!
Get it?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_answer_01

entries.text: Oh, my! Did Pikachu sound like it was in pain to\nyou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_answer_02

entries.text: Oh, my! Did Pikachu sound surprised to\nyou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_answer_03

entries.text: When Pikachu says...[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_10

entries.text: Chaaa!
entries.label: class_d_07_poke_03

entries.text: It’s expressing happiness! Doesn’t it make you\njust want to break out into a happy dance?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_11

entries.text: But I didn’t have to ask Pikachu to put on an act\ntoday. Oh no—I simply asked it to show you all\r\nhow it felt about getting to have class with you![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_12

entries.text: Getting to meet so many new friends and study\ntogether in this class with you...[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_13

entries.text: It’s made both me and my little Pikachu so\nvery happy![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_14

entries.text: And now, apropos of nothing, let me give you\nall one last wise word of advice![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_15

entries.text: As you live your lives, I’m sure you will all have\ntimes when you get mad or sad—maybe even\r\nmore than you would like![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_16

entries.text: Everything has its ups and downs. Life is a\nveritable roller coaster![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_17

entries.text:
But, à la fin—in the end, that is—there is surely
happiness waiting for you!\c
So gardez le sourire—keep a smile on your face—
even in the hardest of times![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_18

entries.text: Chaaa!
entries.label: class_d_07_poke_04

entries.text: When you’re faced with a problem that you can’t\nhandle alone, find someone to rely on, be it a\r\nteacher, your family, your friends—anyone![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_19

entries.text: Our prochain cours—next lesson—will be our\nfinal exam! Be sure to review what we learned\r\nin all our lessons so far! Adios! Mata ne![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_07_language_20
